data.name: Orelle
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'orellein' meaning 'to carry a mountain'. This name is derived from the mythological nymphs of Greek mythology who resided on mountains and protected their forests. Orelle represents strength, endurance, and a deep connection to nature.
